data.one_liner: A utility library to automate mobile emulators and manage screenshots.
data.what_it_does: Automates mobile emulators by wrapping xcrun for iOS and Android CLI tools. Can be used to automate taking screenshots on multiple devices.
use_when: You need to generate screenshots for a Flutter project across multiple devices
You want to automate mobile emulators via command line wrappers
avoid_when: You do not need automation for emulators or screenshots
strengths: Supports cleaning the status bar for clean screenshots
weaknesses: Relies on underlying CLI tools and can encounter platform-specific bugs or issues (e.g., adb or xcrun bugs)
data.setup_notes: Requires platform CLI tools for iOS (xcrun) and Android (adb, avdmanager) to be properly configured.
